title: Next Script shortcut breaks when floating script editor not focused
body:
### Tested versions

Tested in Godot 4.5.1

### System information

Godot v4.5.1.stable - macOS Ventura (13.7.0) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Metal (Forward+) - integrated Apple M1 (Apple7) - Apple M1 (8 threads) - 8.00 GiB memory

### Issue description

The `Script Editor -> Next Script` keyboard shortcut does not work when the Script Editor is floating and focus is on the main Editor, whereas `Editor -> Next Scene Tab` works regardless of which window has focus.

Cases:

  1. Script Editor **docked** and **focused**: both shortcuts work  ✅
  2. Script Editor **floating** and **focused**: both shortcuts work ✅
  3. Script Editor **docked** and another editor focused: `Script Editor -> Next Script` disabled ✅
  4. Script Editor **floating** and another editor focused: `Script Editor -> Next Script` disabled ❌

I drag the floating Script Editor to a second monitor.  It seems that if I can see both editors, I should be able to switch tabs in both editors.  But due to this bug, my Next Script shortcut randomly breaks based on whether I happen to have my Script Editor or my 2D Editor focused.

While I understand that this may make "sense" due to the underlying window heirarchy, it violates the Principle of Least Astonishment :)

### Steps to reproduce

Open multiple scenes and scripts. Detach the Script Editor.  Switch to the 2D or 3D Editor so the Script Editor unfocuses.

Press the `Script Editor -> Next Script` shortcut.

**Expected response:**  Next script.
**Actual response:** Nothing.
